ruleDefinitions.name: Important Scheduled Task Deleted
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects when adversaries try to stop system services or processes by deleting their respective scheduled tasks in order to conduct data destructive activities
 Note: Unmapped fields: TaskName, UserName

sequences.query: (event_id = 141 AND (TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\SystemRestore\\\\SR.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\BitLocker.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\WindowsBackup\\\\.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\WindowsUpdate\\\\.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\UpdateOrchestrator\\\\.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\ExploitGuard.*"))) AND  NOT ((UserName = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR UserName = RGX(".*AUTORI.*")))
